<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Ironbees.Core</id>
    <version>0.13.6</version>
    <authors>iyulab</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/iyulab/ironbees</projectUrl>
    <description>Lightweight filesystem convention-based wrapper for LLM agent frameworks. Simplifies agent loading, routing, and multi-framework integration (Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangChain). Focus on reducing boilerplate, not replacing framework features.</description>
    <releaseNotes>See CHANGELOG.md for release notes</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>Copyright (c) 2025 iyulab</copyright>
    <tags>ai agents multi-agent orchestration llm azure-openai agent-framework convention-based</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/iyulab/ironbees" commit="c19ba26d6786d2792fbc88efa43c247c4b4e400d" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Azure.AI.ContentSafety" version="1.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.AI" version="10.9.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Abstractions" version="10.9.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory" version="10.0.11" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions" version="10.0.11" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions" version="10.0.11" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime" version="1.24.4" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="OpenAI" version="2.12.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Polly" version="8.6.6" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="TokenMeter" version="0.7.4" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="YamlDotNet" version="18.1.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
